verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਪੈ ਆਵਤ ਪਤੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਦੀਪਕਹਿ ਮਹਾਂ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dheepak pai aavat pata(n)g preet reet lag dheepakeh mahaa(n) bipareet mile jaar hai ||

en.bdb: A moth approaches a light out of love but the attitude of a lamp is to the contrary. It singes him to death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਆਵਤ ਕਮਲ ਪਹਿ ਸਨੇਹ ਕਰਿ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਪੁਟਿ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਰਹਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: al chal aavat kamal peh saneh kar kamal sa(n)puT baa(n)dh praan parahaar hai ||

en.bdb: Fulfilling his desire for love, a black bee approaches a lotus flower. But as the Sun sets, the lotus flower closes its petals and snuffs out life from the black bee.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਰਾਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਗਹਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: man bach kram jal meen livaleen gat bichhurat raakh na sakat geh ddaar hai ||

en.bdb: It is the character of fish to stay in water but when a fisherman or angler catches it with the help of a net or a hook, and throws it out of the water, the water does not help it in anyway.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਕੈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਟਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੩੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: dhukhadhaiee preet kee prateet kai marai na Tarai gur sikh sukhadhaiee preet kiau bisaar hai ||318||

en.bdb: One-sided love of fish is full of trust. Every lover dies for its beloved but loves forever. The love of Guru and Sikh is two-sided; the Guru loves his Sikh completely and protects him. So how can a Sikh neglect such warming love of his Guru? (318)
